name: B10-0339/2026 – After § 1 – Am 2
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the joint communication on humanitarian aid (JOIN(2026)0025)
part_text: 1a. Expresses grave concern regarding the blockade and instrumentalisation of humanitarian aid by state and non-state actors for purposes of forced displacement and ethnic cleansing, in violation of international humanitarian law and international human rights law; stresses that such practices deprive the population in the affected territories of goods indispensable to their survival and constitute serious violations of the Geneva Conventions; calls, therefore, for the EU and its Member States to adopt duly justified sanctions against non-EU countries and individuals responsible for these violations;
